text:
Maria: Heads-up from vendor sync: Gaudi asked for a 7-day firmware embargo, NVIDIA pushed a micro-batch of H200 kits 10d later than expected, and there's a kernel driver mismatch for B200 in our k8s images. This impacts marketplace tagging + SI certification windows. Can we triage? cc @Jess @Cheng

Cheng: lab update 9 we have a handful of B200 nodes running, but driver v1.4.2 breaks node-exporter metrics on 6.1 kernels. Need a kernel bump or driver pin.

Jess: SI: we need a stable node image by EOW for partners to run end-to-end tests. If kernel bumps take time, can we produce a parallel image with driver pinned?

Kevin: Yes, we can build a pinned image. Question: do we flip marketplace "available" flag for affected SKUs or leave them hidden until all certs pass?

Maria: prefer hidden until cert + driver verification done. Marketing asked for a soft-announce window; we should avoid that for impacted SKUs.

vendor-feed-bot: Vendor bulletin: Habana/Gaudi firmware embargo request -> 2026-05-17 (requested), NVIDIA H200 tranche delayed to 2026-05-16. B200 driver 1.4.3 incoming ETA 2026-05-06.

Priya: marketing: we can prepare a holding statement and a comms kit, but cannot schedule press distribution until marketplace flags clear. We also need a one-liner about fallback behavior for customers.

Kevin: plan proposal:
- Build `redwood-node:hw-staging-b200-v1` with driver 1.4.2 pinned + kernel 6.2 fallback image `redwood-node:hw-staging-b200-k6.2`
- Tag marketplace SKUs as `available=false` and create `preannounce` metadata label with ETA
- SI: handoff staging tags to integrators on 2026-05-07

Jess: add: include an automated perf smoke script and metrics collection (cpu/gpu/p95 latency) in the image entrypoint so SI can run quick checks without config.

Cheng: I can reserve 6 nodes for SI on 2026-05-08. Need infra ticket for kernel modules and driver consent to be installed at boot.

Maria: I opened PLAT-4972 for kernel module provisioning and PLT-4973 for marketplace metadata. Linking both to this thread.

Nathan: marketing acknowledges hold. We'll prepare the comms kit and a diffed release note showing what changed. Also want a clear fallback statement re: quantized model fallback availability if float32 paths are not ready.

Kevin: about quantized fallback  we can enable a q4_8 fallback profile behind a toggle. That gives us a low-risk path but perf/cost will differ. Need engineering signoff.

Jess: SI: we need that toggle documented and an eval prompt set so partners see behavior differences. If you push the toggle into the staging image, label it `feature.quant_fallback=true` and add a README snippet.

vendor-feed-bot: Internal note: MI300 roadmap unchanged. H100 replenishment scheduled 2026-05-05 (25 units).

Cheng: reserving H100s to absorb early QA to unblock SI if B200 images lag. Will coordinate with lab ops.

Maria: action items recap: (1) Kevin build two staging images (driver-pinned + kernel-6.2) and tag them by 2026-05-06, (2) Cheng reserve 6 SI nodes + 10 H100s as contingency, (3) Jess enable perf smoke harness + quant-fallback toggle documentation, (4) Priya hold press and prepare draft comms kit, (5) Platform tickets PLAT-4972/PLT-4973 owners to close before marketplace flip. Please reply with :thumbsup: or list blockers.

Kevin: :thumbsup: building now, ETA Tue 05/05.

Jess: :thumbsup: will add smoke harness and prompt set.

Cheng: :thumbsup: reserving nodes, will attach job to PLAT-4972.

Priya: prepping comms kit, will wait for signoff.

Maria: thanks. If vendor dates move again we'll reconvene. If anyone finds a regression during smoke, tag the channel and escalate to eng-oncall.
